newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Raisio 4-mth profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Raisio 4-mth profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 71 million markka median forecast for Finnish food, chemicals and animal feeds group Raision Tehtaat Oy Ab's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Raisio's four-month results are due on June 12 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Raisio posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 38.3 million markka.
In February, Raision Tehtaat said the outlook for 1997 was clearly better than in 1996.
The median of six analysts' forecasts for Raisio's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 256 million markka (mean 262 million) in a 231-292 million markka range.
In 1996, Raision Tehtaat's profit was 166 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Evli Securities, Erik Selin, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities and Opstock Securities.
